thesis: The A16z crypto team released their third annual State of Crypto report to provide a holistic, data-driven perspective on the industry's progress, aiming to make complex concepts accessible and shift mainstream conversation away from in-group language. The report argues that 2024 marked a tipping point where infrastructure improvements, such as scalable Layer 2s and high-throughput chains, reduced transaction costs to near zero, enabling real applications to emerge and driving active addresses and mobile wallet users to all-time highs.
